name: Subhankar Saha
bio: Subhankar Saha's research broadly encompasses sustainable operations management, focusing on the agriculture and healthcare sectors, employing both empirical and analytical methodologies. Subhankar completed his PhD in the Production and Operations Management area at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. He has a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Jadavpur University, Kolkata. Subsequently, he worked with Andrew Yule & Company Limited (a manufacturing-based public sector undertaking) in West Bengal, where he served in the Supply Chain Management Department for more than five years. Additionally, he completed the Executive MBA programme at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.

awards.title: Winner, 2026 Babbage International Policy Forum Industrial Innovation Policy Award by the Industry Studies Association.
